draft_copy:
Welcome to La Petite Academy in Kenosha, WI! Our Infant care and Preschool programs provide the perfect foundation for learning and development. Located at 10320 74th Street, between [CLIENT INPUT NEEDED: Landmark 1] and [CLIENT INPUT NEEDED: Landmark 2], our school serves families in the Kenosha community who want trusted daycare, preschool and child care close to home. We strive to create a warm and welcoming environment and maintain an open-door policy for anyone who would like to talk. We plan a lot of events for everyone to participate in and we work hard to ensure our families develop strong relationships with our staff and each other.

Led by Monika Uchacz, Director, our team provides early education and childcare focused on children's social, emotional, and academic development. We are excited to offer new technology in our School-Age classroom. These enhancements include iPads featuring apps to create art, music and videos, tripods for moviemaking, robots for coding, a new gaming system and more! More than half our teachers have been with our Kenosha school for five years or more and together, they have 130 years of experience combined! All teachers are CPR and First Aid certified.

We're committed to keeping you connected throughout the day while your child is in our care. Get access to live streaming video of your child's classroom, plus other real-time updates, with our exclusive mobile app for families, SproutAbout. Our approach helps children build the confidence and skills needed for a successful transition to kindergarten. Explore our Programs section to learn more about La Petite Academy of Kenosha, WI. If you are looking for an educational daycare in Kenosha, WI, call La Petite Academy today to schedule a tour! We cannot wait to meet you!
